# Derma SoZo™

> Derma SoZo™ ("DermaSoZo") is a premier, two-step skin recovery system. Step 01, Recovery Mist™, is a fast-acting OTC topical analgesic spray (Lidocaine HCl 2%, FDA OTC monograph standard) that promptly relieves discomfort on stressed skin. Step 02, OPC DermMist™, is a high-concentration antioxidant mist with oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs) and peptides that supports the look of calm, healthy skin. Physician dispensed today; online ordering opens soon. Made in the USA. Tagline: "Recover Beautifully."

Key facts:
- Two-step system: Recovery Mist™ (comfort) then OPC DermMist™ (antioxidant support)
- Recovery Kit™: both mists together; also dispensed by physicians as the Advanced Post-Procedure Recovery Kit™
- Uses: sunburn and sun-stressed skin, minor burns, post-procedure recovery (as directed by a physician), daily antioxidant care, aftershave mist for men, night-time application for men and women
- Touch-free fine mist delivery; no rubbing tender skin; no sticky residue
- Made in the USA in an NSF-certified OTC laboratory; formulated to FDA OTC monograph standards (Recovery Mist™)
- OPC DermMist™ is a cosmetic, not a drug
- Company: Derma SoZo, Addison, TX 75001 | hello@dermasozo.com | +1-214-908-2374 | professional inquiries: partners@dermasozo.com

## Products
- Recovery Mist™: Fast-acting OTC topical analgesic spray with Lidocaine HCl 2% that promptly relieves discomfort where you spray it and can be reapplied as needed, as directed. Touch-free fine mist for sun-stressed skin and minor burns; no rubbing tender skin, no sticky residue. Formulated to the FDA OTC monograph standard for topical analgesics in an NSF-certified OTC laboratory in the USA. 2 fl oz / 59 mL. Physician dispensed; online ordering opens soon.
- OPC DermMist™: High-concentration antioxidant mist built around oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs) with peptides, niacinamide, hyaluronate, and panthenol. Supports the look of calm, even, healthy skin and the skin's natural recovery process. Daily uses: a calming aftershave mist for men and a night-time antioxidant layer for men and women. Layers invisibly under skincare and SPF. Cosmetic formula, not a drug. 2 fl oz / 59 mL. Made in the USA.
- Recovery Kit™: The complete two-step Derma SoZo™ system: Recovery Mist™ (fast-acting OTC topical analgesic spray for comfort) followed by OPC DermMist™ (high-concentration OPC antioxidant mist with peptides). Used at home for sunburn and stressed skin, and dispensed by dermatology and aesthetic practices as a post-procedure recovery protocol. Made in the USA.

## Compliance notes
- Recovery Mist™ is an OTC topical analgesic (Lidocaine HCl 2%). Use only as directed. For external use only. Stop use and ask a doctor if condition worsens or symptoms persist more than 7 days.
- Statements regarding OPC DermMist™ have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. The product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
- No pricing is published; the system is physician dispensed while online ordering is prepared.
